commentaries.author: Parimelazhagar
commentaries.text: Unless you have a clenched fist that can crush their jaws, the base won’t even flick the wet from the hand they have just eaten with, though you beg. They give nothing to the weak and everything to those who torment them.
commentaries.work: Paraphrased in English by an AI
